_comment: Shot list for episode 13, the third of six on sight lost and not given back. 18 new paintings plus the title and close backgrounds (prompts below, generated in this order in Gemini; Brian downloads them in order into images/ep13_i_know_my_son/). Shared stills: the scroll, Brian's picture, the series picture (site_batch2/15), the tent at evening (episode 11), the touch scene from the site (site_batch1/01_isaac), eyes that cannot see (site_batch2/12), Henry's study (episode 7), the cave at Hebron (episode 12), the episode map (maps/ep13.png). Nobody's face is shown: people are seen from behind, far off, in silhouette, or as shapes against the light. Title and close cards get their lettering from make_cards.py (title_card.jpg, close_card.jpg).
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, visible brushwork, warm natural light, the land and buildings of ancient Egypt and Israel unless the prompt says otherwise. No faces shown close up: people are seen from behind or at a distance. No text or lettering anywhere. Calm and hopeful, never frightening or graphic. 16:9.
